description: Bluetooth Travel Sensors - Individual Traffic Match Files (ITMF) is a dataset listed in City of Austin open data portal (datahub.austintexas.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Austin. For information about the City of Austin's Bluetooth travel sensor data, visit our documentation page: Each row in this dataset represents one Bluetooth enabled device that detected at two locations in the City of Austin's Bluetooth sensor network. Coverage: Austin. The portal files it under the category Transportation and Mobility. Its tags are mobility, travel time, travel sensors, transportation, transit. The table has 11 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Austin, Texas - data.austintexas.gov. The portal shows 2021-12-22 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datahub-austintexas-gov-portal.
